name: Bosch Reutlingen wafer fab expansion
summary: Bosch is enlarging its wafer fab in Reutlingen, Germany, which has mass-produced silicon carbide chips since late 2021. In February 2022 it committed more than EUR 250 million through 2025 to a new extension with 3,600 square metres of cleanroom, due to start production in 2025, as part of growing the site's cleanroom from about 35,000 to over 44,000 square metres by the end of 2025. In July 2022 it put planned Reutlingen spending through 2025 at about EUR 400 million. Bosch reported cleanroom expansion for 200 mm wafers under way in November 2022 and in April 2023 still gave end-2025 as the target.
